comments.author: Tammer
comments.body:
Memorial album of clothing made in factories. As with all factory recipes, you can use the stockpile in your nation's factory for the trade goods. You only need to supply the consumable items and about 200k ducats per recipe.

Butler Suit
Maid Dress
Work Vest
Lace Brim
Work Cap

reward is Large Cloth and Long Thread Cutting Book
